name: incident-response
purpose: Review host evidence exported by the user (Linux: crontab, systemd, authorized_keys, accounts/sudoers, SUID, ps/ss/last; Windows / AD DC: scheduled tasks, services, autostart locations, WMI subscriptions, AD accounts and privileged groups, event log exports; copies of suspicious files) read-only and write persistence traces, IOCs and a timeline into an evidence-backed incident response report
required_input: local path of the evidence folder
risk_reason: No network access, read-only. Input contains possibly malicious file copies and sensitive host data (Windows: AD account lists, ACLs, event logs); writing to the evidence folder is denied by the Policy Gate (@evidence). Bash is limited to hash/count tools for this agent (policy.json agent_shell, stage 2).
